title: HGUET PaymentIntent payload — unreleased draft
description: Exact UTF-8 JSON payload bytes are signed with Ed25519 over HGUET-PAYMENT-INTENT + NUL + payload. The signature and untrusted claimed signer are outside this payload, in signed-payment-intent.schema.json. The user configures the trusted public key independently. Verification proves the intent author signed the bytes; not that the Solana transfer is safe, simulated, or below declared spend cap.

token_spend_limits.description: Optional signed per-mint strict limit on the sum of direct, checked SPL Token and Token-2022 declared source debits in raw integer units (not UI decimals). An empty list allows no direct token debits. Unknown direct token opcodes and uncovered mints are rejected by local Rust verification; CPI and custom-program debits remain UNKNOWN, not an enforced total spend cap. Absence keeps backward-compatible SOL-only intent semantics.

mint.description: Canonical Base58 string decoding to exactly 32 bytes; verified by Rust, including uniqueness across entries.

max_debit_raw.description: Canonical unsigned u64 in mint base units, 0 permitted to prohibit a direct debit; Rust verifies u64 range and the sum of checked debit instructions.

token_source_limits.description: Optional signed strict source-account and required-signer scopes for direct checked token debits. Each source token account may appear only once. Authority must be among the static required signers of the original transaction, not an asserted or confirmed token account owner. Every supported direct token debit must match the mint, source and authority and be within max_debit_raw. Account authority, CPI, multisig, Token-2022 hooks and total spending remain unverified.
